dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Silly Goose was surrendered to the care center as a stray, and we have no history on her behavior in a home environment. During her time at the care center, she has shown social and affiliative behavior with staff, though has also demonstrated a low threshold for arousal, jumping and mouthing persistently when frustrated, and having difficulty redirecting and regulating once overstimulated. Due to these concerns, we recommend placement with a New Hope partner who can provide any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based) and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.

A volunteer writes: Silly Goose is aptly named because she is indeed a little goofball! She loves to run around the yard and play. Like the little bee she's dressed up as, she runs around buzzing about with a squeaky toy we give her. I'm quite certain that she would have entertained herself for hours with that toy if we let her. She is currently being housed in a pop up crate (for the last twenty five days, straight!) and no doubt has a bunch of energy to burn.

I can only imagine the thoughts of the good samaritan who found her as they were walking their own dog. Silly Goose emerged from the bushes and followed the good samaritan until the officers that were on post in that area intervened and took the dog in. If it were me, I'd be unable to believe my luck that such a cute, friendly girl had decided I'd be the one to help her! She was loose and wiggly upon intake and eager to interact with staff. Maybe she had been waiting for the right person, who'd know how to help her before she emerged from those bushes. Now, she's counting the days until a hero can once again come to her rescue and help her out of the shelter! Due to a low threshold for arousal and some handling sensitivity she is available to foster through a New Hope Rescue partner.
dog.name: Silly Goose
